title: Laptop and desktop lessons verified
summary: Bring the phone learning experience to laptop and desktop parts with localized assembly guidance and offline practice.

changes.detail: Understand, Assembly and Try it sections, connected-part navigation, component quizzes, next-piece control and custom AI questions.
Replaced English-only generic assembly notes with Arabic/French/English guides distinguishing laptop soldered CPU/GPU, SO-DIMM RAM and main batteries from desktop components.
Photo taps, picker and component list now open lessons with one action; existing layer reveal, zoom and saved progress retained.

validation.name: Computer regressions
validation.detail: 13 existing tests passed for CPU/GPU reveal, restoring layers, zoom/pan/click suppression, saved progress and trusted teacher context in three languages.

validation.name: New learning interactions
validation.detail: 5 tests passed covering all 28 laptop/desktop lessons, localized device-specific assembly, one-action opening, sections, wrong/correct quiz answers, related/next navigation, focus, progress and validated custom questions.

validation.name: History retention
validation.detail: 6 history tests passed; immutable reports and archive interactions preserved.

validation.name: Static validation
validation.detail: App typecheck and focused ESLint passed after adding explicit validation for missing assembly entries. Initial typecheck flagged possibly undefined guides; corrected before final checks.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Browser visual QA, physical devices and live AI responses were not tested. Automated tests cover teacher routing/context. No deployment.
